factors.value_notes: A Gulf of Maine catch-temperature analysis reports seasonal bottom-temperature associations around 5.34–6.26 °C in spring and 8.43–9.08 °C in fall; NOAA describes Atlantic cod as cold-water and demersal. Stock and season matter, and bottom-temperature observations do not validate the configured 0–16 °C satellite-SST band or 4–12 °C ideal.
